{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check which rows have missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
missing_rows = penguins[penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull() | penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull()]
print('Rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g:')
print(missing_rows[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'species', 'island', 'sex']])

# Check if the missingness is systematic by looking at species and island
print('\nMissingness by species:')
print(penguins.groupby('species')[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].apply(lambda x: x.isnull().sum()))

print('\nMissingness by island:')
print(penguins.groupby('island')[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].apply(lambda x: x.isnull().sum()))"}
